result.title: Tiny Evidence Region Localization with Selective Contrastive On-Policy Self-Distillation
result.summary: Multimodal large language models have made progress in general visual tasks. However, limitations remain in fine-grained visual tasks requiring evidence from minute image regions. Existing methods primarily train models using evidence-related regions while overlooking the influence of extensive background regions, resulting in a limited ability to resist interference from irrelevant regions. We propose selective positive-negative on-policy self-distillation (SPN-OPSD), which considers both evidence and background regions. Supervision from both views improves the model's ability to resist interference from irrelevant regions. Furthermore, selective token-level distillation provides more informative supervision, improving the model's ability to attend to evidence regions in Fine-Grained Visual Tasks. On Qwen3.5-2B, SPN-OPSD improves accuracy on V* Bench, ZoomBench, and MME-RealWorld-Lite from 76.44%, 45.92%, and 57.43% to 84.82%, 54.56%, and 59.56%, respectively. Similar gains are also observed on Qwen3.5-0.8B.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对多模态大模型在细粒度小区域证据任务中易受背景干扰的问题，提出 SPN-OPSD，对证据与背景区域进行选择性正负 on-policy 自蒸馏和 token 级监督，以提升证据定位与抗干扰能力。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 关注的视觉证据筛选及任务必要视觉信息保留直接相关；其 token 级正负蒸馏可能影响模型对证据区域内部状态的编码与使用，值得核查增益究竟来自定位、注意力还是蒸馏监督。
